title: Möbius phase murmuration closure
finding: Recorded phase and amplitude behavior reduces to known 1/zeta and 1/zeta-prime structure; no stable new observable certified.
reopen_condition: A new invariant with a preregistered distinction from the known identities and an originality audit.

title: TDA coupling null result
finding: No coupling was observed in the recorded three-window test.
reopen_condition: A new mathematical coupling mechanism and a power-calibrated protocol.

title: GUE agreement is confirmation, not discovery
finding: Numerical statistics agree closely with the known GUE model; this validates computation but does not create a new theorem or mechanism.
reopen_condition: A PVG-derived statistic with a predeclared deviation prediction not already implied by GUE.

title: Bost-Connes finite-size confirmation
finding: Finite-size behavior near beta=1 reflects the known zeta singularity; no original phase-transition theorem certified.
reopen_condition: A new asymptotic or invariant not reducible to the known zeta pole.

title: Elementary VSDS local-density features
finding: Elementary divisibility-boundary features did not improve held-out local-prime-density prediction beyond the classical baseline.
reopen_condition: A new PVG observable with an independent analytic motivation and frozen protocol.

title: Local-prime-density independent replication
finding: The frozen primary model did not satisfy the promotion rule across all scales; the confidence interval crossed zero and the shortest-window family was negative.
reopen_condition: An analytic mechanism and a new preregistered question; Dataset 004 alone is not sufficient.

title: Hidden Set A concealment defect
finding: The committed authoring generator carried all 48 Set-A gold keys as plaintext literals; running it alone outside the repository re-emitted the keys and reproduced the committed aggregate hash 1987512d exactly, so the gitignored key file and the committed hash conferred no concealment. The staging guard passed throughout because its leakage bar scanned only .jsonl files and matched on filenames. Blast radius is bounded: ARM-CURRENT frozen at 6960cb5 strictly predates the authoring head 3235fd7 and contains no Set-A material, so no key is baked into the measured mind; exposure is a live retrieval channel affecting the 16 B1/B2-tier cases only.
reopen_condition: Evidence that an S2 answering run reached a head containing the generator, or that any Set-A material exists at or before 6960cb5.
classification_note: Negative certificate on a governance concealment defect, classified Diagnostic to stay inside the closed vocabulary of governance/classification-system.md; not a scientific result. Set A is retained, not re-authored: the defect is in the environment and the remedy is the environment pin.

title: Conceptual leakage screen is self-reported on both hidden sets
finding: All 96 cases across Hidden Sets A and B carry leakage_class LEAK-0-CLEAR, but that classification rests on each authoring session screening its own cases. The independent textual screen computed in BENCHMARK-002-LEAKAGE-AUDIT-001 is clear (max 5-gram Jaccard 0.022 across Benchmark 001, both Translation Kernel passes, the Core Ontology, and A-vs-B), yet SEALING §8 makes conceptual leakage outrank textual: a LEAK-2 case scores 0.000 on any n-gram measure and is still disqualifying. No party that did not author the cases has reviewed them for conceptual overlap.
reopen_condition: Closed by an independent conceptual-leakage review of both hidden sets by a reviewer who authored neither.
classification_note: Named missing certificate, not a defect. Does not block G1 — the protocol requires the screen, not an independent re-screen — but it bounds what may be claimed about leakage.
